integrity: Exact Carathéodory–Schur parametrization is maximized over all admissible first three coefficients, including its non-inner possibilities. The unique zero-angle extremum, uniform outward Schur radial derivative, and negative-definite boundary Hessian establish the sharp small-angle envelope. An explicit finite Blaschke witness violates the 2026 manuscript’s bound with a rigorously positive quadratic gap. Exact symbolic derivatives are included as independently reproducible algebraic checks, not as a substitute for the analytic compactness proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the sharp local expansion at real spiral angle tending to zero is proved. The class is locally biholomorphic, with no global univalence requirement. Neither an exact all-angle sharp constant nor a higher-dimensional classification is asserted. The complete 2015 predecessor text was inaccessible; the stated comparison is specifically to the 2026 manuscript’s displayed bound under its stated conditions.
title: Sharp small-angle Hankel law for spirallike convex disk maps
